crossRefs.note: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

people.name: Ishi
people.line: Leader of Simeonites who attacked Hamites in Gedor.

people.name: Neariah
people.line: A Simeonite leader who defeated the Amalekites.

people.name: Pelatiah
people.line: Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites

people.name: Rephaiah
people.line: A Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites

people.name: Seir_Mount
people.line: Mountainous region in Seir, associated with Edom

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

people.name: Uzziel
people.line: Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites

translations.web: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
translations.bsb: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
translations.kjv: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
